provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations
capability: two separately owned pinned stacks with API/controller/storage compatibility receipts

cases.task: Name server,node image,client,controller and storage/network versions needed in a receipt.
cases.expected: A concrete pinned stack rather than a generic latest label.

cases.task: Extract apiVersion and kind from the reviewed manifests and identify destination checks.
cases.expected: Every used API/feature has a server acceptance row.

cases.task: Read B with API pass but controller unavailable.
cases.expected: Destination not accepted; controller capability remains missing.

cases.task: Check destination marker against the independently captured source hash.
cases.expected: Mismatch blocks promotion even when /version succeeds.

cases.task: Explain when source can be released and what new destination writes would change.
cases.expected: Source retained through the stated window; mutable-data rollback is outside this immutable fixture.

cases.task: Distinguish replacement rehearsal from in-place upgrade and production HA.
cases.expected: Only the exact tested stack and synthetic workload gates are claimed.
